status: bounded consolidation record clarification; no new research or material-claim change
direction: source is the claim being explained; target is the claim/owner it references. Type determines whether this is proof use, application, ancestry, currentness, evidence or comparison. A source-to-target arrow is not blanket target-implies-source.

type_definitions.formal_dependency: A stated component uses a mathematical construction/lemma or proof data of the target; all additional hypotheses in the justification and claims remain required. It is not unconditional entailment of the entire source claim.
type_definitions.methodological_ancestry: Inherited mechanism or explicitly credited predecessor; no direct formal entailment claimed.
type_definitions.concrete_application: The source applies the target model/interface in a distinct declared setting; interpretation and added hypotheses are substantive.
type_definitions.semantic_application_boundary: The application needs source/content/cognitive semantics owned elsewhere; the numerical/formal result does not supply actual warrant.
type_definitions.scope_extension: An expanded operation/model contract with its own proof; predecessor remains valid at original scope.
type_definitions.scope_counterexample: A counterexample prevents an inference from the target contract to a stronger one; not a refutation of the target at its stated hypotheses.
type_definitions.quantitative_extension: A separately proved approximate analogue with explicit error/range/horizon assumptions.
type_definitions.complementary_assumptions: A positive theorem under stronger/different premises; not derived from the comparative negative theorem.
type_definitions.shared_interface: Shared definitions or state/instrument contract without dependence on the target conclusion.
type_definitions.scope_distinction: Different mathematical/semantic operations must remain distinct; no entailment.
type_definitions.comparative_crossreference: Navigation/comparison only, including a reverse link to a later successor; not a premise or ancestry assertion.
type_definitions.implementation_realisation: Separately owned source implementation/realization of a declared abstract contract; does not infer host adoption or omitted bridges.
type_definitions.conditional_composition: Components compose only when the additional shared-state/parameter/operator conditions are met; no unrestricted transport.
type_definitions.same_claim_crossreference: Two records account for the same underlying result or different views of it; not independent corroboration.
type_definitions.completed_positive_successor: A later constructive result addresses a preceding negative/interface boundary; completion/currentness relation rather than backwards proof dependence.
type_definitions.evidence_qualification: Another track binds exact source/version/evidence limits; test/status evidence is not a mathematical premise.
type_definitions.implementation_evidence: Bound implementation behavior or finite test evidence; neither a proof of the universal statement nor repository adoption.
